description: VICINITY provides a core ontology for describing the core information to be used in VICINITY ecosystem. qualified_questions.question: [Simple] What are the properties of a system?

PREFIX ssn: <http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/>
PREFIX ssn-system: <http://example.org/ssn-system#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>

PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>

  ?property rdfs:subPropertyOf* ssn:hasProperty .
